name: ynab-mcp-server
description: MCP server exposing the YNAB (You Need A Budget) API as tools.
long_description: An MCP server built with FastMCP that auto-generates tools from the YNAB OpenAPI specification. Lets Claude read and modify your budgets, accounts, categories, transactions, scheduled transactions, and months. Requires a YNAB Personal Access Token.

ynab_api_token.title: YNAB API Token
ynab_api_token.description: Personal Access Token from https://app.ynab.com/settings/developer (Account Settings -> Developer Settings -> New Token).
